Container.Name: Shlink Dashboard
Container.Overview:
Shlink Dashboard provides all the capabilities of shlink-web-client, but with next-level functionality.
The default login and password "admin" could be changed only using HTTPS connection! The application can be accessed only using HTTPS!
1. Install shlink 2. CLI to it and enter "shlink api-key:generate" 3. Copy the api and add to server config in web UI.
Container.DonateText: Find my work useful? Donations are appreciated!
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or Microsoft SQL Server database.

Config.Name: SHLINK_DASHBOARD_DB_DRIVER
Config.Description: Can be postgres, mysql, mariadb or mssql.

Config.Name: SHLINK_DASHBOARD_DB_HOST
Config.Description: The database server host name (your server IP).

Config.Name: SHLINK_DASHBOARD_DB_USER
Config.Description: Username credential for the database connection.

Config.Name: SHLINK_DASHBOARD_DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password credential for the database connection.

Config.Name: SHLINK_DASHBOARD_SESSION_SECRETS
Config.Description: Use a long string of characters.
